goal: Build the per-campaign survey builder: free-form questions and options per campaign, choice questions rejected with zero options, required markers, retire-not-delete for questions with responses, and program scoping.
outcome: TEXT, DROPDOWN, RADIO, MULTI_SELECT and DATE questions with ordered options can be added, edited and removed per campaign; a choice question with zero options is rejected at save time; a question with responses can only be retired, and its rows, historical answers and export survive; the builder seeds no status question; survey edits are allowed in DRAFT and ACTIVE.

requirements.statement: Options are a CHILD TABLE, not a comma-separated string. A label may contain a comma; value is the stable key so a rename does not orphan answers.
The former Status? survey card was removed on purpose — the 13-chip disposition is the only status. Do not seed a second status question.
is_required is enforced by the disposition RPC in story 2.3; render the marker only because it will be enforced.
Retire/Delete states are not drawn — implement them from ux-flows.md section 10a (UX-DR13).
